title: Rust Supply Chain Attack Puts Build-Time Malware in Crates with 245 Million Downloads
summary: The Rust Project has deleted malicious versions of three widely used Rust crates from crates.io after a compromised maintainer account published releases that added a typosquatted dependency whose build script downloaded and executed a remote payload during compilation.
